immersive_spellcraft.game.sigil_inscript: Ink each stroke and lift at its junction.
Hold %1$s or the mouse to ink the stroke; lift at its glowing junction.
immersive_spellcraft.game.scroll_forging: Align the focus, feed the ink, press the seal.
Turn the focus with %2$s/%3$s or the mouse to the green mark, then press %1$s.
Hold %1$s to feed ink; keep the level in the green band until the sigil fills.
Press %1$s as the marker crosses the green seal mark.
immersive_spellcraft.game.glyph_embossin: Align the die, hold the pressure, release on the seal.
Slide the die with %2$s/%3$s or the mouse onto the plate, then press %1$s.
Hold %1$s to press; keep the pressure in the green band while it engraves.
Keep holding %1$s; release as the marker crosses the green seal mark.
